claims: The twelve zodiac signs are 30-degree segments of the zodiac wheel, starting at the vernal equinox.
The twelve zodiac signs represent personality types based on birth dates.
Zodiac signs are classified by elements Fire, Earth, Air, Water.
Zodiac signs are classified by modalities Cardinal, Fixed, Mutable.
Aries is The Ram.
The dates for Aries are March 21 – April 19.
Taurus is The Bull.
The dates for Taurus are April 20 – May 20.
Gemini is The Twins.
The dates for Gemini are May 21 – June 21.
Cancer is The Crab.
The dates for Cancer are June 22 – July 22.
Leo is The Lion.
The dates for Leo are July 23 – August 22.
Virgo is The Maiden.
The dates for Virgo are August 23 – September 22.
Libra is The Scales.
The dates for Libra are September 23 – October 22.
Scorpio is The Scorpion.
The dates for Scorpio are October 23 – November 21.
Sagittarius is The Archer.
The dates for Sagittarius are November 22 – December 21.
Capricorn is The Sea-Goat.
The dates for Capricorn are December 22 – January 19.
Aquarius is The Water-Bearer.
The dates for Aquarius are January 20 – February 18.
Pisces is The Fishes.
The dates for Pisces are February 19 – March 20.
Fire signs are Aries, Leo, Sagittarius.
Earth signs are Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn.
Air signs are Gemini, Libra, Aquarius.
Water signs are Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces.
Cardinal signs are Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn.
Fixed signs are Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius.
Mutable signs are Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces.
The Western zodiac differs from the astronomical zodiac.
The astronomical zodiac includes Ophiuchus (Nov 30–Dec 17).
